ArticleAsOf.description:
What a published article said on a date (task 11b). Only fields that apply to the status
are present: `version` for found / repealed, `gap` for gap, `reason` for unknown_article
(`not_published`) and for a repealed article (`repealed`).
ArticleAsOf.title: ArticleAsOf

ArticleGapOut.description:
An interval with no text on file. It names the amendments that are known to fall in it
and never carries article text (md. 25: a gap cannot be cited).
ArticleGapOut.title: ArticleGapOut

Calculation.description: v1 only says what a calculation needs ("brüt ücret gerekli"); the engine comes in v2.
Calculation.title: Calculation

CaseFacts.description: "Anladığım olay": the case as the agent understood it. The user can correct it.
CaseFacts.title: CaseFacts

ChatEvent.description:
One event of the `text/event-stream` of `POST /chat/conversations/{id}/messages`: the SSE
`event:` line is its `type`, the `data:` line is its JSON.
ChatEvent.title: ChatEvent

CitationRef.description:
A source the answer rests on. Tapping it opens the full text of `source_id` with the part
given by `quote` (and `char_start`..`char_end` in that text) highlighted.
CitationRef.title: CitationRef

Clarification.description:
"Tamamlanması gereken bilgiler" (md. 22). The user answers, marks "Bilmiyorum" or skips;
skipping gives a conditional answer.
Clarification.title: Clarification

DecisionEdits.description:
The `fields` a reviewer may correct, each optional but never null; `full_text` and
`editorial_summary` are not among them. Enum values mirror the schema enums of the app
(checked by its tests).
DecisionEdits.title: DecisionEdits

DoneEvent.description:
The last event. `turn_id` is the assistant turn the feedback goes to (None when the
stream ended in an error).
DoneEvent.title: DoneEvent

ErrorBody.description: `params` carries the values the translated message interpolates; no prose.
ErrorBody.title: ErrorBody

ErrorCode.description:
Every error the API returns, by a stable code; the UI translates it (docs/decisions.md,
2026-10-03). The values are the wire format: add, never rename.
ErrorCode.title: ErrorCode

FactChip.description: A fact the answer rests on, shown above it; tapping it edits the fact.
FactChip.title: FactChip

FileApproval.description:
The final fields of a file, from the approval screen. `doc_type` is required. Every other
field is written as sent (left out = empty), except `supersedes_id`: left out keeps the
version the file was uploaded as, null makes it a document of its own.
FileApproval.title: FileApproval

FileOut.title: FileOut

HoldingRow.description:
One row of the hüküm haritası: a condition of the norm, the case's value for it, the
outcome.
HoldingRow.title: HoldingRow

KbSearchMatch.description:
A chunk that matched, with its place in the record's text (`text[char_start:char_end]`).
A chunk whose license is `internal_only` is never listed.
KbSearchMatch.title: KbSearchMatch

KbSearchResponse.description:
`mode` is `fulltext` when the query could not be embedded (no key, or the embedding
service failed): the ranking then comes from the text index alone.
KbSearchResponse.title: KbSearchResponse

KbSearchResult.description:
One record: a decision, or one version of a statute article. `score` is the best chunk's.
`review_status` is `analyzed` for a record no reviewer has approved yet (show it as "not
approved"). `verification` is the decision's (null for a statute); `valid_from` / `valid_to`
the statute version's validity (null for a decision).
KbSearchResult.title: KbSearchResult

MessageRequest.description:
A question (`text`), the answers to the open questions, or the choice to skip them. The
mode is only the presentation the user has open.
MessageRequest.title: MessageRequest

MissingInfo.description: What a conditional answer depends on: if `condition`, then `result`.
MissingInfo.title: MissingInfo

ReadSources.description:
"Okunanlar", written by the harness from its trace, never by the model. The counts are
those of the distinct sources in `items`.
ReadSources.title: ReadSources

RelatedArticle.description:
One entry of `related_articles`, as the parser writes it: `statute` is the law number
(None when the label could not be mapped), `articles` the article numbers as printed
("18", "17/3"), `raw` the line it came from ("" for an entry added by hand).
RelatedArticle.title: RelatedArticle

ReviewFilters.description: Queue filters shared by the list query string and the bulk-approve body (`band` apart).
ReviewFilters.title: ReviewFilters

ReviewListItem.description:
A queue row. `source_status` is the status of the decision's source. The last-review
fields are None for a decision never reviewed (a reopened one carries its `reopen`); `note`
is the reason of a rejection and None for any other review.
ReviewListItem.title: ReviewListItem

StatuteBulkApproveRequest.description:
Same contract as `BulkApproveRequest`; the cursor is the id of the last article of the
previous call (`next_cursor`), the run goes in id order.
StatuteBulkApproveRequest.title: StatuteBulkApproveRequest

StatuteReviewActionRequest.description: No edits: a timeline is not edited on screen, a wrong one is rejected.
StatuteReviewActionRequest.title: StatuteReviewActionRequest

StatuteReviewListItem.description:
A queue row: the newest extraction of one article. `status` is `pending`, `approved`
(live) or `rejected` here.
StatuteReviewListItem.title: StatuteReviewListItem

StatuteReviewSummary.description: Only the combinations that occur have a row.
StatuteReviewSummary.title: StatuteReviewSummary

StepEvent.description: A live status line ("Kaynaklar okunuyor"); `node` is the name of the step.
StepEvent.title: StepEvent

TimelineGap.description: A gap entry has no text field.
TimelineGap.title: TimelineGap

get.description: The newest version of every document, newest upload first.
How many documents the same filters would list.

delete.description:
Delete a pending file: its row (kept in `file_deletion`), its job when it was the job's
only file, and its blob and text unless another row uses the content. The uploader deletes
their own files, an admin any.

post.description:
Write the final type and fields of a pending file and mark it approved. The uploader may
approve their own file.

Queue the file for another scan; its earlier outcome (and text) is cleared. A file that
is being scanned now is refused, one that is already queued stays as it is.

Take the approval back: the file is pending again (and can be deleted). Refused when the
file has a next version; that one is dealt with first.

get.description:
The original PDF of a decision extraction, for the detail screen.

Copyright: the archive PDFs are pages of the journal Çalışma ve Toplum. They are served
only to a logged-in reviewer, for internal review, never publicly.

The file comes from the file store when the record has a `storage_key` (the import of task
12c fills it) and `FILE_STORE_ROOT` is set. Otherwise it comes from `ARCHIVE_ROOT`: there
`ingest_file.path` is relative to the root (the loader stores the path under the Drive copy,
e.g. `Yargi_Kararlari_Arsivi/...`) and the file is served only if it resolves inside the root
(no `..`, no symlink out). Either way it is served only if it is within
`ARCHIVE_MAX_FILE_BYTES` and its SHA-256 equals `ingest_file.sha256`: no file rather than
the wrong one. It is opened once, and the bytes that were hashed are the bytes sent, so the
file cannot change in between.
